reviewMethod: Individual reading and editorial assessment of each final prompt. Whole-catalogue exact, TF-IDF and LSA candidate retrieval informs semantic adjudication. AI provenance remains separate from human approval.
similarityAdjudication: Read all 200 final prompts for family diversity, voluntary depth and distinct openings. Replaced relative observed with friends because it paraphrased SM-010131; also replaced broad respectful curiosity and outside-family kindness openings. New questions concern family group-chat information, seeing a relative in their own setting, online story consent and archive priorities. Other flagged matches differ in meaning: family hopes versus external changed circumstances, re-entry after absence versus being understood, children hearing disagreement versus general responsibility, specific budget disclosure versus any changed plan. No claim of human review.
